caption:
You still ask what He saw in you. What if it was nothing? He didn't call you for something in you — He reached out first, before you ever turned toward Him. (Galatians 1:6 devotional)

You keep asking what He saw in you, as if the call were a credential you earned. But the reason was never in you — it was in Him: to one with no right to receive, the God with no reason to give reached out first. It cost Him everything to call you, and grace doesn't upgrade the old you; it begins a new one.
